details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B. The orchestrator poller and stall recovery (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C. The clarify, plan or implement phases (`clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`)
D. Documentation only (README, `agents.d/` fragments, `docs/`)
E. Something else: name the file, workflow or feature in your answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for that part?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure: link the failing run, issue or PR (RECOMMENDED)
B. Make it faster or cheaper (fewer API calls, tokens or minutes): name the metric and target
C. Make it more reliable (fewer retries, stalls or human escalations): name the failure mode
D. Add a specific new capability: describe the behaviour you want
E. Improve clarity or docs without changing behaviour
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. A named failure no longer happens, and a regression test covers it (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measured metric reaches a stated threshold
C. A described new behaviour is observable in a workflow run or log line
D. The documentation answers a stated question
